row.commencement_note: The figure in s.4(1) itself, in force from the Part's commencement until notification S.O. 1205(E) of 24.03.2020 raised it to one crore (already approved, OV_IBC_2016_SEC_4_6be1c476ec). The end date 23.03.2020 is the day before that notification; it is not written in this source. Keyed on FILING like the one-crore row; layer 1 checks a threshold only when the filing-date and default-date readings give the same figure (D-069), because tribunals have differed on which date governs.
